remarks: HIGHEST AND BEST OFFERS DUE BY TUESDAY 12/23 @ 12PM. Step into the charm of 19 Barmore Dr E! Located close by High Ridge Rd shopping, restaurants, Whole Foods, the Merritt parkway and quick drive to downtown Stamford. Schedule your showing today!
